items.title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade is pushed into 2027 by apps it would break
items.body: Glamsterdam was originally targeted for December, but developers now say January is the earliest possible date as companies work to fix affected smart contracts.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
items.body: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

items.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
items.body: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

items.title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
items.body: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

items.title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
items.body: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.

items.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
items.body: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.
